style_fingerprint.face: soft molded doll face, large glossy eyes, subtle blush, tiny nose and mouth

installed_optional_method.note: Keep weight moderate because strong human-face identity conditioning can pull the doll face back toward realism.

video.rule: Begin every shot from an approved keyframe derived from the character anchor; do not use free T2V for recurring characters.

prompt_prefix: premium cinematic 3D chibi plush-doll animation, 2.5-head-tall proportions, oversized rounded head, short soft limbs, fine flocked felt fibers, clean fabric seams, soft molded doll face, large glossy eyes with stable highlights, subtle cheek blush, tiny nose and mouth, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic lighting, cute but emotionally restrained
negative_prompt: photorealistic human skin, 2D illustration, flat anime drawing, plastic shine, different hairstyle, different clothing colors, adult-sized child, changed eye color, changed eye highlights, extra characters, duplicate character, missing backpack, long realistic limbs, deformed hands, face drift, text, subtitles, watermark, social media interface, logo
consistency_rules: Approve front and three-quarter character anchors before generating shots.
Keep identity conditioning and style conditioning on separate branches.
Do not change seed as an identity strategy; the anchor image or LoRA is authoritative.
Regenerate a shot keyframe when pose or camera angle changes materially.
Use the same approved keyframe for retries of the same shot.
Route precise full-body actions through pose control after a compatible ControlNet model is installed.
